topic: Binary search halves the search range each step

scenes.visual: 16 sorted boxes appear, target shown, middle box highlighted
scenes.en: We want to find 37 among sixteen sorted numbers. First, check the one in the middle.
scenes.zh: 要在十六個由小到大排好的數字裡找 37。先看正中間的那一個。

scenes.visual: 31 too small: left half dims; then 53 too big, 42 too big: right parts dim
scenes.en: 31 is too small, so the entire left half is gone. Each check throws away half of what is left.
scenes.zh: 31 太小，所以左邊一半全部可以丟掉。每檢查一次，剩下的範圍就砍掉一半。

scenes.en: Sixteen, eight, four, two, one. Four checks find 37, instead of up to sixteen.
scenes.zh: 十六、八、四、二、一。只要檢查四次就找到 37，而不是最多檢查十六次。
